manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Packs a PII-stripped .egg of the current brainstem's persona, custom agents, and calibration baseline, refusing if its content scan finds leaks.
manifest.name: @kody-w/twin_me

action.description: twin_me/pack = build the egg; audit = scan + report only; hatch = materialize a received egg; status = list local eggs/twins.

display_name.description: Optional display name for the twin.

dry_run.description: Scan and report without writing the egg.

egg.description: For action=hatch: path to a .egg to materialize.

flavor.description: basic = persona only (soul + memory agents); full = + your custom agents. Default full.

redact.description: If true, auto-redact any PII found instead of refusing. Default false.
